objects.description: Base class for Vulkan-Hpp dispatch loaders, providing debug-time header version tracking. Not constructed by API; used internally as a common base.

Runtime dispatch loader that retrieves Vulkan function pointers from a Vulkan loader (e.g., via vkGetInstanceProcAddr/vkGetDeviceProcAddr). Use to support dynamic loading without linking to a specific Vulkan library.
Helper that loads the Vulkan shared library and obtains addresses of exported symbols. Used by DispatchLoaderDynamic to bootstrap vkGetInstanceProcAddr and vkGetDeviceProcAddr without linking.
std::error_category implementation for Vulkan-Hpp Result error codes, enabling integration with std::error_code and std::system_error.
Abstract base for Vulkan-Hpp exception hierarchy; mirrors std::exception::what interface but separated for custom error types.
Exception class for logic errors in Vulkan-Hpp usage; derives from std::logic_error and Error.
Exception class for runtime errors arising from Vulkan Result codes; wraps std::system_error with Vulkan-Hpp error_category.
Exception thrown by Vulkan-Hpp when a call returns VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_HOST_MEMORY.

functions.name: vkCreateInstance
functions.signature: VkResult vkCreateInstance(const VkInstanceCreateInfo* pCreateInfo, const VkAllocationCallbacks* pAllocator, VkInstance* pInstance)
functions.description: Create a Vulkan instance object. Typical first call in a Vulkan application used to set up enabled layers/extensions and application/engine info via VkInstanceCreateInfo. Returns a handle to a new VkInstance in pInstance on success.
requirements: pCreateInfo must be a valid, initialized pointer to VkInstanceCreateInfo describing desired layers/extensions
pInstance must be a valid, non-null pointer to receive the created VkInstance
pAllocator may be null or point to a valid VkAllocationCallbacks; if non-null it must remain valid for the lifetime of allocations it controls
On success, returns VK_SUCCESS; on failure, returns a VkResult error code; callers must handle non-success codes

functions.name: vkDestroyInstance
functions.signature: void vkDestroyInstance(VkInstance instance, const VkAllocationCallbacks* pAllocator)
functions.description: Destroy a VkInstance and all child objects created with it (that are not already destroyed), releasing associated resources.
requirements: instance may be VK_NULL_HANDLE (no-op) or a valid VkInstance
pAllocator must be the same allocator provided at creation time if non-null, or null
Must only be called when all operations using instance are complete

functions.name: vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices
functions.signature: VkResult vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices(VkInstance instance, uint32_t* pPhysicalDeviceCount, VkPhysicalDevice* pPhysicalDevices)
functions.description: Enumerate the physical devices (GPUs) available to a Vulkan instance. Two-call idiom: first call with pPhysicalDevices=null to get count, second to retrieve handles.
requirements: instance must be a valid VkInstance
pPhysicalDeviceCount must be a valid, non-null pointer
pPhysicalDevices may be null to query count; otherwise it must point to an array of at least *pPhysicalDeviceCount entries
Returns VK_SUCCESS or VK_INCOMPLETE if the array was too small

functions.name: vkGetPhysicalDeviceFeatures
functions.signature: void vkGetPhysicalDeviceFeatures(VkPhysicalDevice physicalDevice, VkPhysicalDeviceFeatures* pFeatures)
functions.description: Query the supported feature bits of a physical device into VkPhysicalDeviceFeatures.
requirements: physicalDevice must be a valid VkPhysicalDevice from vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices
pFeatures must be a valid, non-null pointer to receive features

functions.name: vkGetPhysicalDeviceFormatProperties
functions.signature: void vkGetPhysicalDeviceFormatProperties(VkPhysicalDevice physicalDevice, VkFormat format, VkFormatProperties* pFormatProperties)
functions.description: Query format capabilities for a given VkFormat on a physical device, returning tiling and usage support in VkFormatProperties.
requirements: physicalDevice must be valid
format must be a valid VkFormat enumeration value
pFormatProperties must be a valid, non-null pointer

functions.name: vkGetPhysicalDeviceImageFormatProperties
functions.signature: VkResult vkGetPhysicalDeviceImageFormatProperties(VkPhysicalDevice physicalDevice, VkFormat format, VkImageType type, VkImageTiling tiling, VkImageUsageFlags usage, VkImageCreateFlags flags, VkImageFormatProperties* pImageFormatProperties)
functions.description: Query limits and capabilities for creating images of a given format, type, tiling, usage and flags on a physical device.
requirements: physicalDevice must be valid
format, type, tiling must be valid enum values; usage and flags are bitmasks per Vulkan spec
pImageFormatProperties must be a valid, non-null pointer
Returns VK_SUCCESS if supported, or an error (e.g., VK_ERROR_FORMAT_NOT_SUPPORTED)

functions.name: vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties
functions.signature: void vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties(VkPhysicalDevice physicalDevice, VkPhysicalDeviceProperties* pProperties)
functions.description: Query general properties and limits of a physical device (API version, driver, limits, sparse props).
requirements: physicalDevice must be valid
pProperties must be a valid, non-null pointer

functions.name: vkGetPhysicalDeviceQueueFamilyProperties
functions.signature: void vkGetPhysicalDeviceQueueFamilyProperties(VkPhysicalDevice physicalDevice, uint32_t* pQueueFamilyPropertyCount, VkQueueFamilyProperties* pQueueFamilyProperties)
functions.description: Enumerate queue family properties supported by a physical device. Two-call idiom to get count and then fill array.
requirements: physicalDevice must be valid
pQueueFamilyPropertyCount must be a valid, non-null pointer
pQueueFamilyProperties may be null to query count; otherwise it must point to an array of at least *pQueueFamilyPropertyCount entries

functions.name: vkGetPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties
functions.signature: void vkGetPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties(VkPhysicalDevice physicalDevice, VkPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties* pMemoryProperties)
functions.description: Query memory heap and type information of a physical device.
requirements: physicalDevice must be valid
pMemoryProperties must be a valid, non-null pointer

functions.name: vkGetInstanceProcAddr
functions.signature: PFN_vkVoidFunction vkGetInstanceProcAddr(VkInstance instance, const char* pName)
functions.description: Query a function pointer for a Vulkan command by name, optionally instance-dependent. Used for dynamic loading of instance and device commands.
requirements: pName must be a valid, null-terminated string with the command name
instance may be VK_NULL_HANDLE for global/instance-level commands; otherwise must be a valid VkInstance
Return value may be NULL if the command is not supported/available; callers must check for NULL before calling

functions.name: vkGetDeviceProcAddr
functions.signature: PFN_vkVoidFunction vkGetDeviceProcAddr(VkDevice device, const char* pName)
functions.description: Query a function pointer for a device-level Vulkan command by name tied to a specific device.
requirements: device must be a valid VkDevice
pName must be a valid, null-terminated string of a device-level command
Return value may be NULL if not supported; callers must check for NULL before use

functions.name: vkCreateDevice
functions.signature: VkResult vkCreateDevice(VkPhysicalDevice physicalDevice, const VkDeviceCreateInfo* pCreateInfo, const VkAllocationCallbacks* pAllocator, VkDevice* pDevice)
functions.description: Create a logical device from a physical device with requested queues, layers, extensions, and features specified in VkDeviceCreateInfo.
requirements: physicalDevice must be a valid VkPhysicalDevice
pCreateInfo must be a valid, initialized pointer to VkDeviceCreateInfo
pDevice must be a valid, non-null pointer to receive the created VkDevice
pAllocator may be null or a valid VkAllocationCallbacks
Returns VK_SUCCESS on success; callers must handle error VkResult codes

functions.name: vkDestroyDevice
functions.signature: void vkDestroyDevice(VkDevice device, const VkAllocationCallbacks* pAllocator)
functions.description: Destroy a VkDevice and free associated resources allocated through it.
requirements: device may be VK_NULL_HANDLE (no-op) or a valid VkDevice
pAllocator must match the allocator used at creation if non-null
Must only be called when the device is idle (no pending work) or after synchronizing

functions.name: vkEnumerateInstanceExtensionProperties
functions.signature: VkResult vkEnumerateInstanceExtensionProperties(const char* pLayerName, uint32_t* pPropertyCount, VkExtensionProperties* pProperties)
functions.description: Enumerate instance extensions supported by the Vulkan implementation or a specific layer if pLayerName is provided. Two-call idiom to get count and properties.
requirements: pPropertyCount must be a valid, non-null pointer
pProperties may be null to query count; otherwise it must point to an array of at least *pPropertyCount entries
pLayerName may be null (query global extensions) or a valid layer name string
Returns VK_SUCCESS or VK_INCOMPLETE if array too small

functions.name: vkEnumerateDeviceExtensionProperties
functions.signature: VkResult vkEnumerateDeviceExtensionProperties(VkPhysicalDevice physicalDevice, const char* pLayerName, uint32_t* pPropertyCount, VkExtensionProperties* pProperties)
functions.description: Enumerate device-level extensions supported by a physical device, optionally filtered by a specific layer. Two-call idiom.
requirements: physicalDevice must be valid
pPropertyCount must be non-null
pProperties may be null to query count; otherwise must have at least *pPropertyCount entries
pLayerName may be null or a valid layer name
Returns VK_SUCCESS or VK_INCOMPLETE if array too small

functions.name: vkEnumerateInstanceLayerProperties
functions.signature: VkResult vkEnumerateInstanceLayerProperties(uint32_t* pPropertyCount, VkLayerProperties* pProperties)
functions.description: Enumerate instance layers available to the application. Two-call idiom for count and properties.
requirements: pPropertyCount must be non-null
pProperties may be null to query count; otherwise must point to an array of at least *pPropertyCount entries
Returns VK_SUCCESS or VK_INCOMPLETE

functions.name: vkEnumerateDeviceLayerProperties
functions.signature: VkResult vkEnumerateDeviceLayerProperties(VkPhysicalDevice physicalDevice, uint32_t* pPropertyCount, VkLayerProperties* pProperties)
functions.description: Enumerate device layers supported by the given physical device (deprecated concept in modern Vulkan but still queryable).
requirements: physicalDevice must be valid
pPropertyCount must be non-null
pProperties may be null to query count; otherwise must have at least *pPropertyCount entries
Returns VK_SUCCESS or VK_INCOMPLETE

functions.name: vkGetDeviceQueue
functions.signature: void vkGetDeviceQueue(VkDevice device, uint32_t queueFamilyIndex, uint32_t queueIndex, VkQueue* pQueue)
functions.description: Retrieve a handle to a device queue created during vkCreateDevice, identified by queueFamilyIndex and queueIndex.
requirements: device must be a valid VkDevice
queueFamilyIndex and queueIndex must identify a queue declared in VkDeviceCreateInfo
pQueue must be a valid, non-null pointer to receive the VkQueue

functions.name: vkQueueSubmit
functions.signature: VkResult vkQueueSubmit(VkQueue queue, uint32_t submitCount, const VkSubmitInfo* pSubmits, VkFence fence)
functions.description: Submit command buffers for execution to a queue, optionally signaling fence when execution completes.
requirements: queue must be a valid VkQueue
submitCount may be zero or greater; if > 0, pSubmits must point to an array of VkSubmitInfo of length submitCount
Each VkSubmitInfo and contained handles must be valid and initialized
fence may be VK_NULL_HANDLE or a valid VkFence
Returns a VkResult; VK_SUCCESS on accepted submission

functions.name: vkQueueWaitIdle
functions.signature: VkResult vkQueueWaitIdle(VkQueue queue)
functions.description: Block until all pending operations on the specified queue have completed.
requirements: queue must be a valid VkQueue
May return a VkResult indicating success or device loss

functions.name: vkDeviceWaitIdle
functions.signature: VkResult vkDeviceWaitIdle(VkDevice device)
functions.description: Block until the device has completed all queued work on all queues.
requirements: device must be a valid VkDevice
May return a VkResult indicating success or device loss

functions.name: vkAllocateMemory
functions.signature: VkResult vkAllocateMemory(VkDevice device, const VkMemoryAllocateInfo* pAllocateInfo, const VkAllocationCallbacks* pAllocator, VkDeviceMemory* pMemory)
functions.description: Allocate a block of device memory according to requirements specified in VkMemoryAllocateInfo.
requirements: device must be valid
pAllocateInfo must be a valid, initialized pointer to VkMemoryAllocateInfo
pMemory must be a valid, non-null pointer to receive VkDeviceMemory
pAllocator may be null or a valid VkAllocationCallbacks
Returns VK_SUCCESS on success, or error codes like VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_DEVICE_MEMORY

functions.name: vkFreeMemory
functions.signature: void vkFreeMemory(VkDevice device, VkDeviceMemory memory, const VkAllocationCallbacks* pAllocator)
functions.description: Free device memory previously allocated with vkAllocateMemory.
requirements: device must be valid
memory may be VK_NULL_HANDLE (no-op) or a valid VkDeviceMemory not currently bound or mapped
pAllocator must match the allocator used for allocation if non-null

functions.name: vkMapMemory
functions.signature: VkResult vkMapMemory(VkDevice device, VkDeviceMemory memory, VkDeviceSize offset, VkDeviceSize size, VkMemoryMapFlags flags, void** ppData)
functions.description: Map a range of a device memory allocation into host address space, returning a host pointer to the mapped range.
requirements: device must be valid
memory must be a valid VkDeviceMemory with host-visible type as required
offset and size define the mapped range; size may be VK_WHOLE_SIZE; range must be within the allocation
flags must be 0 (reserved) per core spec
ppData must be a valid, non-null pointer to receive the mapped address
Returns VK_SUCCESS on success; caller must later call vkUnmapMemory

functions.name: vkUnmapMemory
functions.signature: void vkUnmapMemory(VkDevice device, VkDeviceMemory memory)
functions.description: Unmap a previously mapped device memory allocation.
requirements: device must be valid
memory must be a valid VkDeviceMemory that is currently mapped

functions.name: vkFlushMappedMemoryRanges
functions.signature: VkResult vkFlushMappedMemoryRanges(VkDevice device, uint32_t memoryRangeCount, const VkMappedMemoryRange* pMemoryRanges)
functions.description: Ensure that host writes to mapped memory are made visible to the device for specified ranges (for non-coherent memory).
requirements: device must be valid
If memoryRangeCount > 0, pMemoryRanges must point to an array of VkMappedMemoryRange entries describing mapped ranges to flush
Returns VK_SUCCESS on success; error codes indicate failure

functions.name: vkInvalidateMappedMemoryRanges
functions.signature: VkResult vkInvalidateMappedMemoryRanges(VkDevice device, uint32_t memoryRangeCount, const VkMappedMemoryRange* pMemoryRanges)
functions.description: Invalidate device writes to mapped memory to make them visible to the host (for non-coherent memory) for specified ranges.
requirements: device must be valid
If memoryRangeCount > 0, pMemoryRanges must point to an array of VkMappedMemoryRange entries describing mapped ranges to invalidate
Returns VK_SUCCESS on success

functions.name: vkGetDeviceMemoryCommitment
functions.signature: void vkGetDeviceMemoryCommitment(VkDevice device, VkDeviceMemory memory, VkDeviceSize* pCommittedMemoryInBytes)
functions.description: Query the amount of memory (in bytes) that is currently committed for a given VkDeviceMemory allocation (implementation-dependent).
requirements: device must be valid
memory must be a valid VkDeviceMemory
pCommittedMemoryInBytes must be a valid, non-null pointer

functions.name: vkBindBufferMemory
functions.signature: VkResult vkBindBufferMemory(VkDevice device, VkBuffer buffer, VkDeviceMemory memory, VkDeviceSize memoryOffset)
functions.description: Bind a buffer to a device memory allocation at the given offset.
requirements: device must be valid
buffer must be a valid, created VkBuffer not yet bound (or being rebound per spec rules)
memory must be a valid VkDeviceMemory with appropriate type and size
memoryOffset must be aligned per memory requirements
Returns VK_SUCCESS on success

functions.name: vkBindImageMemory
functions.signature: VkResult vkBindImageMemory(VkDevice device, VkImage image, VkDeviceMemory memory, VkDeviceSize memoryOffset)
functions.description: Bind an image to a device memory allocation at the given offset.
requirements: device must be valid
image must be a valid, created VkImage not yet bound (or being rebound per spec rules)
memory must be valid VkDeviceMemory with sufficient size and correct type
memoryOffset must be aligned per image memory requirements
Returns VK_SUCCESS on success

functions.name: vkGetBufferMemoryRequirements
functions.signature: void vkGetBufferMemoryRequirements(VkDevice device, VkBuffer buffer, VkMemoryRequirements* pMemoryRequirements)
functions.description: Query memory requirements (size, alignment, type bits) for a buffer object.
requirements: device must be valid
buffer must be a valid VkBuffer
pMemoryRequirements must be a valid, non-null pointer

functions.name: vkGetImageMemoryRequirements
functions.signature: void vkGetImageMemoryRequirements(VkDevice device, VkImage image, VkMemoryRequirements* pMemoryRequirements)
functions.description: Query memory requirements (size, alignment, type bits) for an image object.
requirements: device must be valid
image must be a valid VkImage
pMemoryRequirements must be a valid, non-null pointer

functions.name: vkGetImageSparseMemoryRequirements
functions.signature: void vkGetImageSparseMemoryRequirements(VkDevice device, VkImage image, uint32_t* pSparseMemoryRequirementCount, VkSparseImageMemoryRequirements* pSparseMemoryRequirements)
functions.description: Query sparse memory requirements for an image that supports sparse binding/aliasing.
requirements: device must be valid
image must be a valid VkImage
pSparseMemoryRequirementCount must be non-null
pSparseMemoryRequirements may be null to query count; otherwise must point to an array with at least *pSparseMemoryRequirementCount entries

functions.name: vkGetPhysicalDeviceSparseImageFormatProperties
functions.signature: void vkGetPhysicalDeviceSparseImageFormatProperties(VkPhysicalDevice physicalDevice, VkFormat format, VkImageType type, VkSampleCountFlagBits samples, VkImageUsageFlags usage, VkImageTiling tiling, uint32_t* pPropertyCount, VkSparseImageFormatProperties* pProperties)
functions.description: Query properties of sparse image formats supported for a given format/type/samples/usage/tiling on a physical device.
requirements: physicalDevice must be valid
format, type, samples, usage, tiling must be valid enums/flags per spec
pPropertyCount must be non-null
pProperties may be null to query count; otherwise must point to an array with at least *pPropertyCount entries

functions.name: vkQueueBindSparse
functions.signature: VkResult vkQueueBindSparse(VkQueue queue, uint32_t bindInfoCount, const VkBindSparseInfo* pBindInfo, VkFence fence)
functions.description: Submit sparse memory binding operations to a queue to bind memory to buffers/images with sparse residency features.
requirements: queue must be valid
If bindInfoCount > 0, pBindInfo must point to an array of VkBindSparseInfo entries, each properly initialized
fence may be VK_NULL_HANDLE or a valid VkFence
Returns VkResult indicating submission acceptance

functions.name: vkCreateFence
functions.signature: VkResult vkCreateFence(VkDevice device, const VkFenceCreateInfo* pCreateInfo, const VkAllocationCallbacks* pAllocator, VkFence* pFence)
functions.description: Create a fence synchronization object which can be signaled by the GPU or host and waited upon.
requirements: device must be valid
pCreateInfo must be a valid, initialized pointer to VkFenceCreateInfo
pFence must be non-null
pAllocator optional
Returns VK_SUCCESS on success

functions.name: vkDestroyFence
functions.signature: void vkDestroyFence(VkDevice device, VkFence fence, const VkAllocationCallbacks* pAllocator)
functions.description: Destroy a fence object and free associated resources.
requirements: device must be valid
fence may be VK_NULL_HANDLE or a valid VkFence
pAllocator must match allocator used at creation if non-null
Fence must not be in use by the device at destruction

functions.name: vkResetFences
functions.signature: VkResult vkResetFences(VkDevice device, uint32_t fenceCount, const VkFence* pFences)
functions.description: Reset one or more fences to the unsignaled state.
requirements: device must be valid
If fenceCount > 0, pFences must point to an array of valid VkFence handles
Returns VK_SUCCESS on success

functions.name: vkGetFenceStatus
functions.signature: VkResult vkGetFenceStatus(VkDevice device, VkFence fence)
functions.description: Query the status of a fence (signaled or not). Non-blocking.
requirements: device must be valid
fence must be a valid VkFence
Returns VK_SUCCESS if signaled, VK_NOT_READY if not yet signaled, or error codes

functions.name: vkWaitForFences
functions.signature: VkResult vkWaitForFences(VkDevice device, uint32_t fenceCount, const VkFence* pFences, VkBool32 waitAll, uint64_t timeout)
functions.description: Wait for one or more fences to become signaled, optionally all of them, with a timeout in nanoseconds.
requirements: device must be valid
If fenceCount > 0, pFences must point to an array of valid VkFence handles
waitAll is VK_TRUE to wait for all, VK_FALSE to wait for any
timeout in nanoseconds; use UINT64_MAX for effectively infinite wait
Returns VK_SUCCESS if condition met, VK_TIMEOUT otherwise

functions.name: vkCreateSemaphore
functions.signature: VkResult vkCreateSemaphore(VkDevice device, const VkSemaphoreCreateInfo* pCreateInfo, const VkAllocationCallbacks* pAllocator, VkSemaphore* pSemaphore)
functions.description: Create a semaphore synchronization object.
requirements: device must be valid
pCreateInfo must be a valid, initialized VkSemaphoreCreateInfo pointer
pSemaphore must be non-null
pAllocator optional
Returns VK_SUCCESS on success

functions.name: vkDestroySemaphore
functions.signature: void vkDestroySemaphore(VkDevice device, VkSemaphore semaphore, const VkAllocationCallbacks* pAllocator)
functions.description: Destroy a semaphore and free associated resources.
requirements: device must be valid
semaphore may be VK_NULL_HANDLE or a valid VkSemaphore
pAllocator must match allocator used at creation if non-null

functions.name: vkCreateQueryPool
functions.signature: VkResult vkCreateQueryPool(VkDevice device, const VkQueryPoolCreateInfo* pCreateInfo, const VkAllocationCallbacks* pAllocator, VkQueryPool* pQueryPool)
functions.description: Create a query pool to record query results (timestamps, occlusion, pipeline statistics, etc.).
requirements: device must be valid
pCreateInfo must be a valid, initialized VkQueryPoolCreateInfo
pQueryPool must be non-null
pAllocator optional
Returns VK_SUCCESS on success

functions.name: vkDestroyQueryPool
functions.signature: void vkDestroyQueryPool(VkDevice device, VkQueryPool queryPool, const VkAllocationCallbacks* pAllocator)
functions.description: Destroy a query pool and free associated resources.
requirements: device must be valid
queryPool may be VK_NULL_HANDLE or a valid VkQueryPool
pAllocator must match allocator used at creation if non-null

functions.name: vkGetQueryPoolResults
functions.signature: VkResult vkGetQueryPoolResults(VkDevice device, VkQueryPool queryPool, uint32_t firstQuery, uint32_t queryCount, size_t dataSize, void* pData, VkDeviceSize stride, VkQueryResultFlags flags)
functions.description: Retrieve results from queries recorded into a query pool into host memory.
requirements: device must be valid
queryPool must be a valid VkQueryPool
pData must point to a buffer of at least dataSize bytes
dataSize and stride must be sized/aligned per Vulkan spec and flags
Returns VK_SUCCESS if all requested results are available, VK_NOT_READY if not (unless flags allow partial)

functions.name: vkCreateBuffer
functions.signature: VkResult vkCreateBuffer(VkDevice device, const VkBufferCreateInfo* pCreateInfo, const VkAllocationCallbacks* pAllocator, VkBuffer* pBuffer)
functions.description: Create a buffer object of specified size/usage/sharing as described in VkBufferCreateInfo.
requirements: device must be valid
pCreateInfo must be valid and initialized
pBuffer must be non-null
pAllocator optional
Returns VK_SUCCESS on success

functions.name: vkDestroyBuffer
functions.signature: void vkDestroyBuffer(VkDevice device, VkBuffer buffer, const VkAllocationCallbacks* pAllocator)
functions.description: Destroy a buffer object and free associated resources (after unbinding/destroying dependent resources).
requirements: device must be valid
buffer may be VK_NULL_HANDLE or a valid VkBuffer not in use
pAllocator must match allocator used at creation if non-null

functions.name: vkCreateImage
functions.signature: VkResult vkCreateImage(VkDevice device, const VkImageCreateInfo* pCreateInfo, const VkAllocationCallbacks* pAllocator, VkImage* pImage)
functions.description: Create an image object with properties described in VkImageCreateInfo (format, extent, tiling, usage, etc.).
requirements: device must be valid
pCreateInfo must be valid and initialized
pImage must be non-null
pAllocator optional
Returns VK_SUCCESS on success

functions.name: vkDestroyImage
functions.signature: void vkDestroyImage(VkDevice device, VkImage image, const VkAllocationCallbacks* pAllocator)
functions.description: Destroy an image and free associated resources (must be unbound and not in use).
requirements: device must be valid
image may be VK_NULL_HANDLE or a valid VkImage
pAllocator must match allocator used at creation if non-null

functions.name: vkGetImageSubresourceLayout
functions.signature: void vkGetImageSubresourceLayout(VkDevice device, VkImage image, const VkImageSubresource* pSubresource, VkSubresourceLayout* pLayout)
functions.description: Query the layout (offset, size, row pitch, etc.) of a specific subresource of a linear-tiled image.
requirements: device must be valid
image must be a valid VkImage (typically linear tiled)
pSubresource and pLayout must be valid, non-null pointers

functions.name: vkCreateImageView
functions.signature: VkResult vkCreateImageView(VkDevice device, const VkImageViewCreateInfo* pCreateInfo, const VkAllocationCallbacks* pAllocator, VkImageView* pView)
functions.description: Create an image view describing how an image is accessed in shaders (format reinterpretation, subresource ranges, components).
requirements: device must be valid
pCreateInfo must be valid and initialized
pView must be non-null
pAllocator optional
Returns VK_SUCCESS on success

functions.name: vkDestroyImageView
functions.signature: void vkDestroyImageView(VkDevice device, VkImageView imageView, const VkAllocationCallbacks* pAllocator)
functions.description: Destroy an image view.
requirements: device must be valid
imageView may be VK_NULL_HANDLE or a valid VkImageView
pAllocator must match allocator used at creation if non-null

functions.name: vkCreateCommandPool
functions.signature: VkResult vkCreateCommandPool(VkDevice device, const VkCommandPoolCreateInfo* pCreateInfo, const VkAllocationCallbacks* pAllocator, VkCommandPool* pCommandPool)
functions.description: Create a command pool from which command buffers of a specific queue family can be allocated.
requirements: device must be valid
pCreateInfo must be valid and initialized (queueFamilyIndex, flags)
pCommandPool must be non-null
pAllocator optional
Returns VK_SUCCESS on success

functions.name: vkDestroyCommandPool
functions.signature: void vkDestroyCommandPool(VkDevice device, VkCommandPool commandPool, const VkAllocationCallbacks* pAllocator)
functions.description: Destroy a command pool, implicitly freeing all command buffers allocated from it.
requirements: device must be valid
commandPool may be VK_NULL_HANDLE or a valid VkCommandPool
Pool must not be in use
pAllocator must match allocator used at creation if non-null

functions.name: vkResetCommandPool
functions.signature: VkResult vkResetCommandPool(VkDevice device, VkCommandPool commandPool, VkCommandPoolResetFlags flags)
functions.description: Reset a command pool and optionally release resources; invalidates command buffers allocated from it depending on flags.
requirements: device must be valid
commandPool must be a valid VkCommandPool
flags is a bitmask per Vulkan spec
Returns VK_SUCCESS on success

functions.name: vkAllocateCommandBuffers
functions.signature: VkResult vkAllocateCommandBuffers(VkDevice device, const VkCommandBufferAllocateInfo* pAllocateInfo, VkCommandBuffer* pCommandBuffers)
functions.description: Allocate one or more command buffers from a command pool.
requirements: device must be valid
pAllocateInfo must be valid and initialized (commandPool, level, count)
pCommandBuffers must point to an array with at least commandBufferCount entries
Returns VK_SUCCESS on success

functions.name: vkFreeCommandBuffers
functions.signature: void vkFreeCommandBuffers(VkDevice device, VkCommandPool commandPool, uint32_t commandBufferCount, const VkCommandBuffer* pCommandBuffers)
functions.description: Free one or more command buffers back to the command pool.
requirements: device must be valid
commandPool must be a valid VkCommandPool the buffers were allocated from
If commandBufferCount > 0, pCommandBuffers must point to an array of valid VkCommandBuffer handles

functions.name: vkBeginCommandBuffer
functions.signature: VkResult vkBeginCommandBuffer(VkCommandBuffer commandBuffer, const VkCommandBufferBeginInfo* pBeginInfo)
functions.description: Start recording a command buffer using parameters in VkCommandBufferBeginInfo (usage flags, inheritance for secondary buffers).
requirements: commandBuffer must be a valid, allocated VkCommandBuffer in the initial state
pBeginInfo must be a valid, initialized pointer
Returns VK_SUCCESS on success

functions.name: vkEndCommandBuffer
functions.signature: VkResult vkEndCommandBuffer(VkCommandBuffer commandBuffer)
functions.description: End recording of a command buffer, transitioning it to the executable state.
requirements: commandBuffer must be valid and currently recording
Returns VK_SUCCESS on success

functions.name: vkResetCommandBuffer
functions.signature: VkResult vkResetCommandBuffer(VkCommandBuffer commandBuffer, VkCommandBufferResetFlags flags)
functions.description: Reset a command buffer to the initial state so it can be re-recorded.
requirements: commandBuffer must be valid
flags is a bitmask per Vulkan spec
Returns VK_SUCCESS on success

functions.name: vkCmdCopyBuffer
functions.signature: void vkCmdCopyBuffer(VkCommandBuffer commandBuffer, VkBuffer srcBuffer, VkBuffer dstBuffer, uint32_t regionCount, const VkBufferCopy* pRegions)
functions.description: Record a command to copy data between two buffers over specified regions.
requirements: commandBuffer must be a valid, recording VkCommandBuffer
srcBuffer and dstBuffer must be valid VkBuffer handles
If regionCount > 0, pRegions must point to an array of VkBufferCopy entries

functions.name: vkCmdCopyImage
functions.signature: void vkCmdCopyImage(VkCommandBuffer commandBuffer, VkImage srcImage, VkImageLayout srcImageLayout, VkImage dstImage, VkImageLayout dstImageLayout, uint32_t regionCount, const VkImageCopy* pRegions)
functions.description: Record a command to copy image data between images with given layouts and regions.
requirements: commandBuffer must be valid and recording
srcImage, dstImage valid VkImage handles
Layouts must match the current image layouts at execution time
If regionCount > 0, pRegions must point to an array of VkImageCopy entries

functions.name: vkCmdCopyBufferToImage
functions.signature: void vkCmdCopyBufferToImage(VkCommandBuffer commandBuffer, VkBuffer srcBuffer, VkImage dstImage, VkImageLayout dstImageLayout, uint32_t regionCount, const VkBufferImageCopy* pRegions)
functions.description: Record a command to copy data from a buffer into an image (e.g., upload textures).
requirements: commandBuffer must be recording
srcBuffer valid VkBuffer; dstImage valid VkImage
dstImageLayout must match the image's current layout at execution time
If regionCount > 0, pRegions must point to an array of VkBufferImageCopy entries

functions.name: vkCmdCopyImageToBuffer
functions.signature: void vkCmdCopyImageToBuffer(VkCommandBuffer commandBuffer, VkImage srcImage, VkImageLayout srcImageLayout, VkBuffer dstBuffer, uint32_t regionCount, const VkBufferImageCopy* pRegions)
functions.description: Record a command to copy image data into a buffer (e.g., readback).
requirements: commandBuffer must be recording
srcImage and dstBuffer must be valid
srcImageLayout must match image's current layout at execution time
If regionCount > 0, pRegions must point to an array of VkBufferImageCopy entries

functions.name: vkCmdUpdateBuffer
functions.signature: void vkCmdUpdateBuffer(VkCommandBuffer commandBuffer, VkBuffer dstBuffer, VkDeviceSize dstOffset, VkDeviceSize dataSize, const void* pData)
functions.description: Record a command to update a buffer with small amounts of data embedded in the command buffer.
requirements: commandBuffer must be recording
dstBuffer must be valid
pData must point to at least dataSize bytes; dataSize must meet Vulkan constraints (e.g., <= 65536 and multiples per spec)
dstOffset and dataSize must be aligned per spec

functions.name: vkCmdFillBuffer
functions.signature: void vkCmdFillBuffer(VkCommandBuffer commandBuffer, VkBuffer dstBuffer, VkDeviceSize dstOffset, VkDeviceSize size, uint32_t data)
functions.description: Record a command to fill a buffer region with a 32-bit pattern value.
requirements: commandBuffer must be recording
dstBuffer must be valid
dstOffset and size must be aligned per spec (4-byte alignment)
size may be VK_WHOLE_SIZE to fill to end

functions.name: vkCmdPipelineBarrier
functions.signature: void vkCmdPipelineBarrier(VkCommandBuffer commandBuffer, VkPipelineStageFlags srcStageMask, VkPipelineStageFlags dstStageMask, VkDependencyFlags dependencyFlags, uint32_t memoryBarrierCount, const VkMemoryBarrier* pMemoryBarriers, uint32_t bufferMemoryBarrierCount, const VkBufferMemoryBarrier* pBufferMemoryBarriers, uint32_t imageMemoryBarrierCount, const VkImageMemoryBarrier* pImageMemoryBarriers)
functions.description: Record a pipeline barrier to synchronize resource access and perform layout transitions using memory, buffer, and image barriers.
requirements: commandBuffer must be recording
Stage masks and barrier arrays must be valid per Vulkan synchronization rules
If counts > 0, corresponding pointers must point to arrays of that length with valid structs

functions.name: vkCmdBeginQuery
functions.signature: void vkCmdBeginQuery(VkCommandBuffer commandBuffer, VkQueryPool queryPool, uint32_t query, VkQueryControlFlags flags)
functions.description: Begin a query at the specified index in a query pool (occlusion, pipeline statistics, etc.).
requirements: commandBuffer must be recording
queryPool must be valid and of appropriate type for usage
query index must be within the pool's range

functions.name: vkCmdEndQuery
functions.signature: void vkCmdEndQuery(VkCommandBuffer commandBuffer, VkQueryPool queryPool, uint32_t query)
functions.description: End a query that was previously begun with vkCmdBeginQuery.
requirements: commandBuffer must be recording
queryPool must be valid
query index must match a begun query

functions.name: vkCmdResetQueryPool
functions.signature: void vkCmdResetQueryPool(VkCommandBuffer commandBuffer, VkQueryPool queryPool, uint32_t firstQuery, uint32_t queryCount)
functions.description: Reset a range of queries in a query pool so they can be used again.
requirements: commandBuffer must be recording and support reset usage per spec
queryPool must be valid
firstQuery + queryCount must be within pool size

functions.name: vkCmdWriteTimestamp
functions.signature: void vkCmdWriteTimestamp(VkCommandBuffer commandBuffer, VkPipelineStageFlagBits pipelineStage, VkQueryPool queryPool, uint32_t query)
functions.description: Write a timestamp into a query pool slot at a specified pipeline stage.
requirements: commandBuffer must be recording
queryPool must be a valid timestamp-capable pool
query index must be within range
pipelineStage must be a valid stage bit

functions.name: vkCmdCopyQueryPoolResults
functions.signature: void vkCmdCopyQueryPoolResults(VkCommandBuffer commandBuffer, VkQueryPool queryPool, uint32_t firstQuery, uint32_t queryCount, VkBuffer dstBuffer, VkDeviceSize dstOffset, VkDeviceSize stride, VkQueryResultFlags flags)
functions.description: Record a command to copy query results to a buffer with specified stride and result flags.
requirements: commandBuffer must be recording
queryPool and dstBuffer must be valid
Range firstQuery..firstQuery+queryCount-1 must be within pool
dstOffset and stride must satisfy alignment constraints

functions.name: vkCmdExecuteCommands
functions.signature: void vkCmdExecuteCommands(VkCommandBuffer commandBuffer, uint32_t commandBufferCount, const VkCommandBuffer* pCommandBuffers)
functions.description: Execute an array of secondary command buffers within a primary command buffer.
requirements: commandBuffer must be a primary command buffer currently recording
If commandBufferCount > 0, pCommandBuffers must point to array of valid secondary command buffers in executable state
All state inheritance and usage rules must be satisfied

functions.name: vkCreateEvent
functions.signature: VkResult vkCreateEvent(VkDevice device, const VkEventCreateInfo* pCreateInfo, const VkAllocationCallbacks* pAllocator, VkEvent* pEvent)
functions.description: Create an event object for lightweight host/device synchronization.
requirements: device must be valid
pCreateInfo must be valid and initialized
pEvent must be non-null
pAllocator optional
Returns VK_SUCCESS on success

functions.name: vkDestroyEvent
functions.signature: void vkDestroyEvent(VkDevice device, VkEvent event, const VkAllocationCallbacks* pAllocator)
functions.description: Destroy an event object.
requirements: device must be valid
event may be VK_NULL_HANDLE or a valid VkEvent
pAllocator must match allocator used at creation if non-null

functions.name: vkGetEventStatus
functions.signature: VkResult vkGetEventStatus(VkDevice device, VkEvent event)
functions.description: Query whether an event is set (signaled) or reset.
requirements: device must be valid
event must be a valid VkEvent
Returns VK_EVENT_SET, VK_EVENT_RESET, or error

functions.name: vkSetEvent
functions.signature: VkResult vkSetEvent(VkDevice device, VkEvent event)
functions.description: Set (signal) an event from the host.
requirements: device must be valid
event must be a valid VkEvent
Returns VK_SUCCESS on success

functions.name: vkResetEvent
functions.signature: VkResult vkResetEvent(VkDevice device, VkEvent event)
functions.description: Reset (unsignal) an event from the host.
requirements: device must be valid
event must be a valid VkEvent
Returns VK_SUCCESS on success

functions.name: vkCreateBufferView
functions.signature: VkResult vkCreateBufferView(VkDevice device, const VkBufferViewCreateInfo* pCreateInfo, const VkAllocationCallbacks* pAllocator, VkBufferView* pView)
functions.description: Create a typed view into a buffer for use in descriptors (format and range specified).
requirements: device must be valid
pCreateInfo must be valid and initialized
pView must be non-null
pAllocator optional
Returns VK_SUCCESS on success

functions.name: vkDestroyBufferView
functions.signature: void vkDestroyBufferView(VkDevice device, VkBufferView bufferView, const VkAllocationCallbacks* pAllocator)
functions.description: Destroy a buffer view object.
requirements: device must be valid
bufferView may be VK_NULL_HANDLE or a valid VkBufferView
pAllocator must match allocator used at creation if non-null

functions.name: vkCreateShaderModule
functions.signature: VkResult vkCreateShaderModule(VkDevice device, const VkShaderModuleCreateInfo* pCreateInfo, const VkAllocationCallbacks* pAllocator, VkShaderModule* pShaderModule)
functions.description: Create a shader module from SPIR-V bytecode provided in VkShaderModuleCreateInfo.
requirements: device must be valid
pCreateInfo must be valid and initialized, containing valid SPIR-V code pointer/size
pShaderModule must be non-null
pAllocator optional
Returns VK_SUCCESS on success or error (e.g., VK_ERROR_INVALID_SHADER_NV in some paths)

functions.name: vkDestroyShaderModule
functions.signature: void vkDestroyShaderModule(VkDevice device, VkShaderModule shaderModule, const VkAllocationCallbacks* pAllocator)
functions.description: Destroy a shader module object.
requirements: device must be valid
shaderModule may be VK_NULL_HANDLE or a valid VkShaderModule
pAllocator must match allocator used at creation if non-null

functions.name: vkCreatePipelineCache
functions.signature: VkResult vkCreatePipelineCache(VkDevice device, const VkPipelineCacheCreateInfo* pCreateInfo, const VkAllocationCallbacks* pAllocator, VkPipelineCache* pPipelineCache)
functions.description: Create a pipeline cache used to store and reuse pipeline compilation data.
requirements: device must be valid
pCreateInfo must be valid and initialized (optionally with initial data)
pPipelineCache must be non-null
pAllocator optional
Returns VK_SUCCESS on success

functions.name: vkDestroyPipelineCache
functions.signature: void vkDestroyPipelineCache(VkDevice device, VkPipelineCache pipelineCache, const VkAllocationCallbacks* pAllocator)
functions.description: Destroy a pipeline cache object.
requirements: device must be valid
pipelineCache may be VK_NULL_HANDLE or valid VkPipelineCache
pAllocator must match allocator used at creation if non-null

functions.name: vkGetPipelineCacheData
functions.signature: VkResult vkGetPipelineCacheData(VkDevice device, VkPipelineCache pipelineCache, size_t* pDataSize, void* pData)
functions.description: Retrieve binary data from a pipeline cache. Two-call idiom: first to query size, then to copy data.
requirements: device must be valid
pipelineCache must be valid
pDataSize must be non-null
pData may be null to query size; otherwise must point to a buffer of at least *pDataSize bytes
Returns VK_SUCCESS on success; may return VK_INCOMPLETE if buffer too small

functions.name: vkMergePipelineCaches
functions.signature: VkResult vkMergePipelineCaches(VkDevice device, VkPipelineCache dstCache, uint32_t srcCacheCount, const VkPipelineCache* pSrcCaches)
functions.description: Merge one or more pipeline caches into a destination cache, potentially improving cache hit rates.
requirements: device must be valid
dstCache must be a valid VkPipelineCache
If srcCacheCount > 0, pSrcCaches must point to an array of valid VkPipelineCache handles
Returns VK_SUCCESS on success

functions.name: vkCreateComputePipelines
functions.signature: VkResult vkCreateComputePipelines(VkDevice device, VkPipelineCache pipelineCache, uint32_t createInfoCount, const VkComputePipelineCreateInfo* pCreateInfos, const VkAllocationCallbacks* pAllocator, VkPipeline* pPipelines)
functions.description: Create one or more compute pipelines as described by VkComputePipelineCreateInfo structures, optionally using a pipeline cache.
requirements: device must be valid
pCreateInfos must point to an array of createInfoCount initialized VkComputePipelineCreateInfo entries
pPipelines must point to an array with at least createInfoCount entries
pipelineCache may be VK_NULL_HANDLE or a valid VkPipelineCache
pAllocator optional
Returns VK_SUCCESS on full success; may return error and leave some pipelines invalid

functions.name: vkDestroyPipeline
functions.signature: void vkDestroyPipeline(VkDevice device, VkPipeline pipeline, const VkAllocationCallbacks* pAllocator)
functions.description: Destroy a graphics/compute/ray tracing pipeline object.
requirements: device must be valid
pipeline may be VK_NULL_HANDLE or a valid VkPipeline
pAllocator must match allocator used at creation if non-null

functions.name: vkCreatePipelineLayout
functions.signature: VkResult vkCreatePipelineLayout(VkDevice device, const VkPipelineLayoutCreateInfo* pCreateInfo, const VkAllocationCallbacks* pAllocator, VkPipelineLayout* pPipelineLayout)
functions.description: Create a pipeline layout describing descriptor set layouts and push constant ranges used by pipelines.
requirements: device must be valid
pCreateInfo must be valid and initialized
pPipelineLayout must be non-null
pAllocator optional
Returns VK_SUCCESS on success

functions.name: vkDestroyPipelineLayout
functions.signature: void vkDestroyPipelineLayout(VkDevice device, VkPipelineLayout pipelineLayout, const VkAllocationCallbacks* pAllocator)
functions.description: Destroy a pipeline layout.
requirements: device must be valid
pipelineLayout may be VK_NULL_HANDLE or a valid VkPipelineLayout
pAllocator must match allocator used at creation if non-null

functions.name: vkCreateSampler
functions.signature: VkResult vkCreateSampler(VkDevice device, const VkSamplerCreateInfo* pCreateInfo, const VkAllocationCallbacks* pAllocator, VkSampler* pSampler)
functions.description: Create a sampler object controlling texture sampling parameters.
requirements: device must be valid
pCreateInfo must be valid and initialized
pSampler must be non-null
pAllocator optional
Returns VK_SUCCESS on success

functions.name: vkDestroySampler
functions.signature: void vkDestroySampler(VkDevice device, VkSampler sampler, const VkAllocationCallbacks* pAllocator)
functions.description: Destroy a sampler object.
requirements: device must be valid
sampler may be VK_NULL_HANDLE or a valid VkSampler
pAllocator must match allocator used at creation if non-null

functions.name: vkCreateDescriptorSetLayout
functions.signature: VkResult vkCreateDescriptorSetLayout(VkDevice device, const VkDescriptorSetLayoutCreateInfo* pCreateInfo, const VkAllocationCallbacks* pAllocator, VkDescriptorSetLayout* pSetLayout)
functions.description: Create a descriptor set layout defining descriptor bindings for sets used by pipelines.
requirements: device must be valid
pCreateInfo must be valid and initialized
pSetLayout must be non-null
pAllocator optional
Returns VK_SUCCESS on success

functions.name: vkDestroyDescriptorSetLayout
functions.signature: void vkDestroyDescriptorSetLayout(VkDevice device, VkDescriptorSetLayout descriptorSetLayout, const VkAllocationCallbacks* pAllocator)
functions.description: Destroy a descriptor set layout.
requirements: device must be valid
descriptorSetLayout may be VK_NULL_HANDLE or a valid VkDescriptorSetLayout
pAllocator must match allocator used at creation if non-null

functions.name: vkCreateDescriptorPool
functions.signature: VkResult vkCreateDescriptorPool(VkDevice device, const VkDescriptorPoolCreateInfo* pCreateInfo, const VkAllocationCallbacks* pAllocator, VkDescriptorPool* pDescriptorPool)
functions.description: Create a descriptor pool from which descriptor sets can be allocated.
requirements: device must be valid
pCreateInfo must be valid and initialized
pDescriptorPool must be non-null
pAllocator optional
Returns VK_SUCCESS on success

functions.name: vkDestroyDescriptorPool
functions.signature: void vkDestroyDescriptorPool(VkDevice device, VkDescriptorPool descriptorPool, const VkAllocationCallbacks* pAllocator)
functions.description: Destroy a descriptor pool, implicitly freeing any sets allocated from it (unless free flag disallows).
requirements: device must be valid
descriptorPool may be VK_NULL_HANDLE or a valid VkDescriptorPool
pAllocator must match allocator used at creation if non-null

functions.name: vkResetDescriptorPool
functions.signature: VkResult vkResetDescriptorPool(VkDevice device, VkDescriptorPool descriptorPool, VkDescriptorPoolResetFlags flags)
functions.description: Reset a descriptor pool, returning all sets allocated from it to the pool for reuse.
requirements: device must be valid
descriptorPool must be valid
flags is a bitmask per Vulkan spec
Returns VK_SUCCESS on success

functions.name: vkAllocateDescriptorSets
functions.signature: VkResult vkAllocateDescriptorSets(VkDevice device, const VkDescriptorSetAllocateInfo* pAllocateInfo, VkDescriptorSet* pDescriptorSets)
functions.description: Allocate one or more descriptor sets from a descriptor pool according to the provided layouts.
requirements: device must be valid
pAllocateInfo must be valid and initialized
pDescriptorSets must point to an array of at least descriptorSetCount entries
Returns VK_SUCCESS on success

functions.name: vkFreeDescriptorSets
functions.signature: VkResult vkFreeDescriptorSets(VkDevice device, VkDescriptorPool descriptorPool, uint32_t descriptorSetCount, const VkDescriptorSet* pDescriptorSets)
functions.description: Free descriptor sets back to a pool, if the pool supports individual free.
requirements: device must be valid
descriptorPool must be valid and support free if used
If descriptorSetCount > 0, pDescriptorSets must point to an array of valid VkDescriptorSet handles
Returns VK_SUCCESS on success

functions.name: vkUpdateDescriptorSets
functions.signature: void vkUpdateDescriptorSets(VkDevice device, uint32_t descriptorWriteCount, const VkWriteDescriptorSet* pDescriptorWrites, uint32_t descriptorCopyCount, const VkCopyDescriptorSet* pDescriptorCopies)
functions.description: Update the contents of descriptor sets with write and/or copy operations.
requirements: device must be valid
If descriptorWriteCount > 0, pDescriptorWrites must point to an array of valid VkWriteDescriptorSet
If descriptorCopyCount > 0, pDescriptorCopies must point to an array of valid VkCopyDescriptorSet
Descriptors referenced must be compatible with their layouts

functions.name: vkCmdBindPipeline
functions.signature: void vkCmdBindPipeline(VkCommandBuffer commandBuffer, VkPipelineBindPoint pipelineBindPoint, VkPipeline pipeline)
functions.description: Bind a pipeline object to the command buffer for subsequent draws or dispatches.
requirements: commandBuffer must be recording
pipelineBindPoint must be a valid VkPipelineBindPoint
pipeline must be a valid VkPipeline compatible with the bind point

functions.name: vkCmdBindDescriptorSets
functions.signature: void vkCmdBindDescriptorSets(VkCommandBuffer commandBuffer, VkPipelineBindPoint pipelineBindPoint, VkPipelineLayout layout, uint32_t firstSet, uint32_t descriptorSetCount, const VkDescriptorSet* pDescriptorSets, uint32_t dynamicOffsetCount, const uint32_t* pDynamicOffsets)
functions.description: Bind one or more descriptor sets to a command buffer for a given pipeline layout and bind point.
requirements: commandBuffer must be recording
layout must be a valid VkPipelineLayout compatible with bound pipeline
If descriptorSetCount > 0, pDescriptorSets must point to an array of valid sets
If dynamicOffsetCount > 0, pDynamicOffsets must point to an array of offsets

functions.name: vkCmdClearColorImage
functions.signature: void vkCmdClearColorImage(VkCommandBuffer commandBuffer, VkImage image, VkImageLayout imageLayout, const VkClearColorValue* pColor, uint32_t rangeCount, const VkImageSubresourceRange* pRanges)
functions.description: Record a command to clear color values in an image over specified subresource ranges.
requirements: commandBuffer must be recording
image must be a valid color image
imageLayout must match current layout allowing clear operations
pColor must be a valid pointer; if rangeCount > 0, pRanges must point to array of ranges

functions.name: vkCmdDispatch
functions.signature: void vkCmdDispatch(VkCommandBuffer commandBuffer, uint32_t groupCountX, uint32_t groupCountY, uint32_t groupCountZ)
functions.description: Record a compute dispatch for the specified number of workgroups in each dimension.
requirements: commandBuffer must be recording with a compute pipeline bound
groupCountX/Y/Z can be zero or more; zero may result in no-op per spec

functions.name: vkCmdDispatchIndirect
functions.signature: void vkCmdDispatchIndirect(VkCommandBuffer commandBuffer, VkBuffer buffer, VkDeviceSize offset)
functions.description: Record an indirect compute dispatch with parameters read from a buffer at the given offset.
requirements: commandBuffer must be recording with a compute pipeline bound
buffer must be valid and contain a VkDispatchIndirectCommand at offset with proper alignment

functions.name: vkCmdSetEvent
functions.signature: void vkCmdSetEvent(VkCommandBuffer commandBuffer, VkEvent event, VkPipelineStageFlags stageMask)
functions.description: Record a command to set (signal) an event when prior commands reach stageMask.
requirements: commandBuffer must be recording
event must be a valid VkEvent
stageMask must be valid per spec

functions.name: vkCmdResetEvent
functions.signature: void vkCmdResetEvent(VkCommandBuffer commandBuffer, VkEvent event, VkPipelineStageFlags stageMask)
functions.description: Record a command to reset an event after prior commands reach stageMask.
requirements: commandBuffer must be recording
event must be a valid VkEvent
stageMask must be valid per spec

functions.name: vkCmdWaitEvents
functions.signature: void vkCmdWaitEvents(VkCommandBuffer commandBuffer, uint32_t eventCount, const VkEvent* pEvents, VkPipelineStageFlags srcStageMask, VkPipelineStageFlags dstStageMask, uint32_t memoryBarrierCount, const VkMemoryBarrier* pMemoryBarriers, uint32_t bufferMemoryBarrierCount, const VkBufferMemoryBarrier* pBufferMemoryBarriers, uint32_t imageMemoryBarrierCount, const VkImageMemoryBarrier* pImageMemoryBarriers)
functions.description: Record a command to wait on one or more events and then apply specified memory barriers for synchronization between stages.
requirements: commandBuffer must be recording
If eventCount > 0, pEvents must point to valid VkEvent handles
Stage masks and barrier arrays must be valid; if a count > 0, corresponding pointer must reference an array of that length

functions.name: vkCmdPushConstants
functions.signature: void vkCmdPushConstants(VkCommandBuffer commandBuffer, VkPipelineLayout layout, VkShaderStageFlags stageFlags, uint32_t offset, uint32_t size, const void* pValues)
functions.description: Record a command to update push constant values for shaders stages in the given layout.
requirements: commandBuffer must be recording
layout must be compatible with the bound pipeline
stageFlags must specify valid stages used by layout's push constants
offset and size must be within declared push constant ranges
pValues must point to at least size bytes

functions.name: vkCreateGraphicsPipelines
functions.signature: VkResult vkCreateGraphicsPipelines(VkDevice device, VkPipelineCache pipelineCache, uint32_t createInfoCount, const VkGraphicsPipelineCreateInfo* pCreateInfos, const VkAllocationCallbacks* pAllocator, VkPipeline* pPipelines)
functions.description: Create one or more graphics pipelines as described by VkGraphicsPipelineCreateInfo structures, optionally using a pipeline cache.
requirements: device must be valid
pCreateInfos must point to an array of createInfoCount initialized VkGraphicsPipelineCreateInfo entries
pPipelines must point to an array with at least createInfoCount entries
pipelineCache may be VK_NULL_HANDLE or valid
pAllocator optional
Returns VK_SUCCESS on full success; partial failures may occur with error codes

functions.name: vkCreateFramebuffer
functions.signature: VkResult vkCreateFramebuffer(VkDevice device, const VkFramebufferCreateInfo* pCreateInfo, const VkAllocationCallbacks* pAllocator, VkFramebuffer* pFramebuffer)
functions.description: Create a framebuffer compatible with a render pass using specified attachments and dimensions.
requirements: device must be valid
pCreateInfo must be valid and initialized
pFramebuffer must be non-null
pAllocator optional
Returns VK_SUCCESS on success

functions.name: vkDestroyFramebuffer
functions.signature: void vkDestroyFramebuffer(VkDevice device, VkFramebuffer framebuffer, const VkAllocationCallbacks* pAllocator)
functions.description: Destroy a framebuffer.
requirements: device must be valid
framebuffer may be VK_NULL_HANDLE or valid VkFramebuffer
pAllocator must match allocator used at creation if non-null

functions.name: vkCreateRenderPass
functions.signature: VkResult vkCreateRenderPass(VkDevice device, const VkRenderPassCreateInfo* pCreateInfo, const VkAllocationCallbacks* pAllocator, VkRenderPass* pRenderPass)
functions.description: Create a render pass describing subpasses, attachments, and dependencies.
requirements: device must be valid
pCreateInfo must be valid and initialized
pRenderPass must be non-null
pAllocator optional
Returns VK_SUCCESS on success

functions.name: vkDestroyRenderPass
functions.signature: void vkDestroyRenderPass(VkDevice device, VkRenderPass renderPass, const VkAllocationCallbacks* pAllocator)
functions.description: Destroy a render pass.
requirements: device must be valid
renderPass may be VK_NULL_HANDLE or a valid VkRenderPass
pAllocator must match allocator used at creation if non-null

functions.name: vkGetRenderAreaGranularity
functions.signature: void vkGetRenderAreaGranularity(VkDevice device, VkRenderPass renderPass, VkExtent2D* pGranularity)
functions.description: Query the optimal render area granularity for a render pass which can be used to align render areas for better performance.
requirements: device must be valid
renderPass must be a valid VkRenderPass
pGranularity must be a valid, non-null pointer

functions.name: vkCmdSetViewport
functions.signature: void vkCmdSetViewport(VkCommandBuffer commandBuffer, uint32_t firstViewport, uint32_t viewportCount, const VkViewport* pViewports)
functions.description: Record dynamic state to set one or more viewports.
requirements: commandBuffer must be recording
If viewportCount > 0, pViewports must point to an array of VkViewport entries

functions.name: vkCmdSetScissor
functions.signature: void vkCmdSetScissor(VkCommandBuffer commandBuffer, uint32_t firstScissor, uint32_t scissorCount, const VkRect2D* pScissors)
functions.description: Record dynamic state to set one or more scissor rectangles.
requirements: commandBuffer must be recording
If scissorCount > 0, pScissors must point to an array of VkRect2D entries

functions.name: vkCmdSetLineWidth
functions.signature: void vkCmdSetLineWidth(VkCommandBuffer commandBuffer, float lineWidth)
functions.description: Record dynamic state to set line width for rasterization (if enabled and supported).
requirements: commandBuffer must be recording
lineWidth must be within device limits

functions.name: vkCmdSetDepthBias
functions.signature: void vkCmdSetDepthBias(VkCommandBuffer commandBuffer, float depthBiasConstantFactor, float depthBiasClamp, float depthBiasSlopeFactor)
functions.description: Record dynamic state to set depth bias parameters.
requirements: commandBuffer must be recording

functions.name: vkCmdSetBlendConstants
functions.signature: void vkCmdSetBlendConstants(VkCommandBuffer commandBuffer, const float blendConstants[4])
functions.description: Record dynamic state to set blend constant RGBA values.
requirements: commandBuffer must be recording
blendConstants must point to 4 floats

functions.name: vkCmdSetDepthBounds
functions.signature: void vkCmdSetDepthBounds(VkCommandBuffer commandBuffer, float minDepthBounds, float maxDepthBounds)
functions.description: Record dynamic state to set depth bounds for depth bounds test, if enabled.
requirements: commandBuffer must be recording
minDepthBounds and maxDepthBounds must be within [0,1] and min <= max

functions.name: vkCmdSetStencilCompareMask
functions.signature: void vkCmdSetStencilCompareMask(VkCommandBuffer commandBuffer, VkStencilFaceFlags faceMask, uint32_t compareMask)
functions.description: Record dynamic state to set stencil compare mask for specified faces.
requirements: commandBuffer must be recording
faceMask must specify front/back/both faces

functions.name: vkCmdSetStencilWriteMask
functions.signature: void vkCmdSetStencilWriteMask(VkCommandBuffer commandBuffer, VkStencilFaceFlags faceMask, uint32_t writeMask)
functions.description: Record dynamic state to set stencil write mask for specified faces.
requirements: commandBuffer must be recording
faceMask must specify front/back/both faces

functions.name: vkCmdSetStencilReference
functions.signature: void vkCmdSetStencilReference(VkCommandBuffer commandBuffer, VkStencilFaceFlags faceMask, uint32_t reference)
functions.description: Record dynamic state to set stencil reference value for specified faces.
requirements: commandBuffer must be recording
faceMask must specify front/back/both faces

functions.name: vkCmdBindIndexBuffer
functions.signature: void vkCmdBindIndexBuffer(VkCommandBuffer commandBuffer, VkBuffer buffer, VkDeviceSize offset, VkIndexType indexType)
functions.description: Bind an index buffer for indexed draw commands.
requirements: commandBuffer must be recording
buffer must be a valid VkBuffer with sufficient size
offset must be aligned to indexType size
indexType must be a valid VkIndexType

functions.name: vkCmdBindVertexBuffers
functions.signature: void vkCmdBindVertexBuffers(VkCommandBuffer commandBuffer, uint32_t firstBinding, uint32_t bindingCount, const VkBuffer* pBuffers, const VkDeviceSize* pOffsets)
functions.description: Bind one or more vertex buffers to input bindings for subsequent draw commands.
requirements: commandBuffer must be recording
If bindingCount > 0, pBuffers and pOffsets must point to arrays of at least bindingCount entries; each buffer must be valid and large enough

functions.name: vkCmdDraw
functions.signature: void vkCmdDraw(VkCommandBuffer commandBuffer, uint32_t vertexCount, uint32_t instanceCount, uint32_t firstVertex, uint32_t firstInstance)
functions.description: Record a non-indexed draw call.
requirements: commandBuffer must be recording with a graphics pipeline bound and necessary state set
vertexCount and instanceCount specify the number of vertices and instances

functions.name: vkCmdDrawIndexed
functions.signature: void vkCmdDrawIndexed(VkCommandBuffer commandBuffer, uint32_t indexCount, uint32_t instanceCount, uint32_t firstIndex, int32_t vertexOffset, uint32_t firstInstance)
functions.description: Record an indexed draw call.
requirements: commandBuffer must be recording with graphics pipeline bound and an index buffer bound
indexCount and instanceCount specify number of indices and instances

functions.name: vkCmdDrawIndirect
functions.signature: void vkCmdDrawIndirect(VkCommandBuffer commandBuffer, VkBuffer buffer, VkDeviceSize offset, uint32_t drawCount, uint32_t stride)
functions.description: Record multiple non-indexed draws with parameters sourced from a buffer.
requirements: commandBuffer must be recording
buffer must be valid and contain draw parameters; offset must be aligned
stride must be at least sizeof(VkDrawIndirectCommand)

functions.name: vkCmdDrawIndexedIndirect
functions.signature: void vkCmdDrawIndexedIndirect(VkCommandBuffer commandBuffer, VkBuffer buffer, VkDeviceSize offset, uint32_t drawCount, uint32_t stride)
functions.description: Record multiple indexed draws with parameters sourced from a buffer.
requirements: commandBuffer must be recording
buffer must be valid and contain draw parameters; offset aligned
stride must be at least sizeof(VkDrawIndexedIndirectCommand)

functions.name: vkCmdBlitImage
functions.signature: void vkCmdBlitImage(VkCommandBuffer commandBuffer, VkImage srcImage, VkImageLayout srcImageLayout, VkImage dstImage, VkImageLayout dstImageLayout, uint32_t regionCount, const VkImageBlit* pRegions, VkFilter filter)
functions.description: Record a command to blit (scaled copy) between images, potentially performing format conversion and filtering.
requirements: commandBuffer must be recording
srcImage and dstImage must be valid and in correct layouts
If regionCount > 0, pRegions must point to array of VkImageBlit entries
filter must be a valid VkFilter

functions.name: vkCmdClearDepthStencilImage
functions.signature: void vkCmdClearDepthStencilImage(VkCommandBuffer commandBuffer, VkImage image, VkImageLayout imageLayout, const VkClearDepthStencilValue* pDepthStencil, uint32_t rangeCount, const VkImageSubresourceRange* pRanges)
functions.description: Record a command to clear depth and/or stencil aspects of an image over specified ranges.
requirements: commandBuffer must be recording
image must be a valid depth/stencil image; imageLayout must allow clear
pDepthStencil and pRanges (if rangeCount > 0) must be valid

functions.name: vkCmdClearAttachments
functions.signature: void vkCmdClearAttachments(VkCommandBuffer commandBuffer, uint32_t attachmentCount, const VkClearAttachment* pAttachments, uint32_t rectCount, const VkClearRect* pRects)
functions.description: Record commands to clear attachments within the current render pass using scissored rectangles.
requirements: commandBuffer must be recording and inside a render pass instance
If attachmentCount > 0, pAttachments must point to VkClearAttachment array
If rectCount > 0, pRects must point to VkClearRect array

functions.name: vkCmdResolveImage
functions.signature: void vkCmdResolveImage(VkCommandBuffer commandBuffer, VkImage srcImage, VkImageLayout srcImageLayout, VkImage dstImage, VkImageLayout dstImageLayout, uint32_t regionCount, const VkImageResolve* pRegions)
functions.description: Record commands to resolve multisampled image into a non-multisampled image over regions.
requirements: commandBuffer must be recording
srcImage and dstImage must be valid and in correct layouts
If regionCount > 0, pRegions must point to array of VkImageResolve entries

functions.name: vkCmdBeginRenderPass
functions.signature: void vkCmdBeginRenderPass(VkCommandBuffer commandBuffer, const VkRenderPassBeginInfo* pRenderPassBegin, VkSubpassContents contents)
functions.description: Begin a render pass instance with specified framebuffer, clear values, and area. Subsequent draw commands apply to this render pass.
requirements: commandBuffer must be recording and a primary command buffer
pRenderPassBegin must be valid and initialized; framebuffer/renderPass compatible
contents must be a valid VkSubpassContents value

functions.name: vkCmdNextSubpass
functions.signature: void vkCmdNextSubpass(VkCommandBuffer commandBuffer, VkSubpassContents contents)
functions.description: Advance to the next subpass within the current render pass instance.
requirements: commandBuffer must be recording within a render pass
contents must be a valid VkSubpassContents

functions.name: vkCmdEndRenderPass
functions.signature: void vkCmdEndRenderPass(VkCommandBuffer commandBuffer)
functions.description: End the current render pass instance.
requirements: commandBuffer must be recording and currently inside a render pass

functions.name: vkEnumerateInstanceVersion
functions.signature: VkResult vkEnumerateInstanceVersion(uint32_t* pApiVersion)
functions.description: Query the highest supported Vulkan API version by the loader/implementation.
requirements: pApiVersion must be a valid, non-null pointer
Returns VK_SUCCESS on success

functions.name: vkBindBufferMemory2
functions.signature: VkResult vkBindBufferMemory2(VkDevice device, uint32_t bindInfoCount, const VkBindBufferMemoryInfo* pBindInfos)
functions.description: Bind one or more ranges of VkDeviceMemory to VkBuffer objects in a single call. Typical usage is after creating buffers and allocating device memory, to associate each buffer with an offset into the allocation.
requirements: device must be a valid VkDevice handle created from the same VkPhysicalDevice that allocated the memory
bindInfoCount must match the number of elements in pBindInfos and may be >= 1
pBindInfos must point to an array of bindInfoCount valid VkBindBufferMemoryInfo structs
Each VkBindBufferMemoryInfo must have sType set to VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BIND_BUFFER_MEMORY_INFO and a properly formed pNext chain
Each VkBindBufferMemoryInfo::buffer must be a valid buffer handle created on device
Each VkBindBufferMemoryInfo::memory must be a valid VkDeviceMemory allocated on device
Each VkBindBufferMemoryInfo::memoryOffset must satisfy alignment and range requirements for the buffer per vkGetBufferMemoryRequirements(2)
A given buffer must be in the unbound state or otherwise valid to be (re)bound as per Vulkan spec

functions.name: vkBindImageMemory2
functions.signature: VkResult vkBindImageMemory2(VkDevice device, uint32_t bindInfoCount, const VkBindImageMemoryInfo* pBindInfos)
functions.description: Bind one or more ranges of VkDeviceMemory to VkImage objects in a single call. Used after image creation and memory allocation to associate images with their memory.
requirements: device must be a valid VkDevice
bindInfoCount must be >= 1 and match the number of entries in pBindInfos
pBindInfos must point to bindInfoCount valid VkBindImageMemoryInfo structs
Each VkBindImageMemoryInfo must have sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BIND_IMAGE_MEMORY_INFO and a valid pNext chain
image handles in VkBindImageMemoryInfo must be valid images created on device
memory handles must be valid VkDeviceMemory objects allocated on device
memoryOffset must meet the alignment and size requirements returned by vkGetImageMemoryRequirements(2) for the image
The image’s tiling/flags/sparse requirements must be compatible with the binding

functions.name: vkGetDeviceGroupPeerMemoryFeatures
functions.signature: void vkGetDeviceGroupPeerMemoryFeatures(VkDevice device, uint32_t heapIndex, uint32_t localDeviceIndex, uint32_t remoteDeviceIndex, VkPeerMemoryFeatureFlags* pPeerMemoryFeatures)
functions.description: Query supported peer memory features between two physical devices in a device group for a given memory heap. Use to determine if peer reads/writes/copies are supported between local and remote devices.
requirements: device must be a valid logical device created with a device group
heapIndex must be a valid memory heap index for the device’s physical device group
localDeviceIndex and remoteDeviceIndex must be valid indices into the device group (less than the group size)
pPeerMemoryFeatures must be a valid pointer to receive bitmask VkPeerMemoryFeatureFlags

functions.name: vkCmdSetDeviceMask
functions.signature: void vkCmdSetDeviceMask(VkCommandBuffer commandBuffer, uint32_t deviceMask)
functions.description: Set the device mask for subsequent commands recorded into commandBuffer in a device-group scenario. Controls which physical devices in the group execute subsequent work.
requirements: commandBuffer must be a valid VkCommandBuffer in the recording state (inside vkBeginCommandBuffer/vkEndCommandBuffer)
deviceMask must be a non-zero bitmask of devices in the group and valid for the command buffer’s device mask capabilities

functions.name: vkEnumeratePhysicalDeviceGroups
functions.signature: VkResult vkEnumeratePhysicalDeviceGroups(VkInstance instance, uint32_t* pPhysicalDeviceGroupCount, VkPhysicalDeviceGroupProperties* pPhysicalDeviceGroupProperties)
functions.description: Enumerate physical device groups available to an instance. First call with pPhysicalDeviceGroupProperties = nullptr to get the count, then allocate an array and call again to retrieve properties.
requirements: instance must be a valid VkInstance
pPhysicalDeviceGroupCount must be a valid pointer to receive the count
If pPhysicalDeviceGroupProperties is not null, it must point to an array with at least *pPhysicalDeviceGroupCount elements of VkPhysicalDeviceGroupProperties
On output, each VkPhysicalDeviceGroupProperties::sType will be set by the implementation; caller should set sType/pNext if required by version (commonly zero-initialized is sufficient)

functions.name: vkGetImageMemoryRequirements2
functions.signature: void vkGetImageMemoryRequirements2(VkDevice device, const VkImageMemoryRequirementsInfo2* pInfo, VkMemoryRequirements2* pMemoryRequirements)
functions.description: Query memory requirements for an image using the extensible Info2/Requirements2 structures, allowing pNext chains for extended queries.
requirements: device must be a valid VkDevice
pInfo must be a valid pointer to VkImageMemoryRequirementsInfo2 with sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_MEMORY_REQUIREMENTS_INFO_2 and valid image handle
pMemoryRequirements must be a valid pointer to VkMemoryRequirements2 with sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_REQUIREMENTS_2 and any required pNext
Image must have been created on device

functions.name: vkGetBufferMemoryRequirements2
functions.signature: void vkGetBufferMemoryRequirements2(VkDevice device, const VkBufferMemoryRequirementsInfo2* pInfo, VkMemoryRequirements2* pMemoryRequirements)
functions.description: Query memory requirements for a buffer using the Info2/Requirements2 structures, supporting extensions via pNext.
requirements: device must be valid
pInfo must point to VkBufferMemoryRequirementsInfo2 with sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_MEMORY_REQUIREMENTS_INFO_2 and a valid buffer handle
pMemoryRequirements must point to VkMemoryRequirements2 with sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_REQUIREMENTS_2
Buffer must have been created on device

functions.name: vkGetImageSparseMemoryRequirements2
functions.signature: void vkGetImageSparseMemoryRequirements2(VkDevice device, const VkImageSparseMemoryRequirementsInfo2* pInfo, uint32_t* pSparseMemoryRequirementCount, VkSparseImageMemoryRequirements2* pSparseMemoryRequirements)
functions.description: Query sparse memory requirements for an image with support for extension chains. Returns the number of sparse memory requirement structures and fills them if provided.
requirements: device must be a valid VkDevice
pInfo must point to VkImageSparseMemoryRequirementsInfo2 with sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_SPARSE_MEMORY_REQUIREMENTS_INFO_2 and a valid image
pSparseMemoryRequirementCount must be a valid pointer
If pSparseMemoryRequirements is not null, it must point to an array of at least *pSparseMemoryRequirementCount VkSparseImageMemoryRequirements2 elements

functions.name: vkGetPhysicalDeviceFeatures2
functions.signature: void vkGetPhysicalDeviceFeatures2(VkPhysicalDevice physicalDevice, VkPhysicalDeviceFeatures2* pFeatures)
functions.description: Query core and extended (via pNext) physical device features. pFeatures may include a pNext chain of feature structs to be filled.
requirements: physicalDevice must be a valid VkPhysicalDevice from vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices
pFeatures must point to VkPhysicalDeviceFeatures2 with sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_FEATURES_2; any extension feature structs must be in pNext with correct sType

functions.name: vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties2
functions.signature: void vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties2(VkPhysicalDevice physicalDevice, VkPhysicalDeviceProperties2* pProperties)
functions.description: Query core and extended (via pNext) physical device properties. Fills VkPhysicalDeviceProperties2 and any pNext property structs.
requirements: physicalDevice must be valid
pProperties must point to VkPhysicalDeviceProperties2 with sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_PROPERTIES_2; any extension property structs in pNext must have correct sType

functions.name: vkGetPhysicalDeviceFormatProperties2
functions.signature: void vkGetPhysicalDeviceFormatProperties2(VkPhysicalDevice physicalDevice, VkFormat format, VkFormatProperties2* pFormatProperties)
functions.description: Retrieve format properties for a given VkFormat, with extensible output via VkFormatProperties2 pNext chain.
requirements: physicalDevice must be valid
format must be a valid VkFormat enum value
pFormatProperties must point to VkFormatProperties2 with sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_FORMAT_PROPERTIES_2

functions.name: vkGetPhysicalDeviceImageFormatProperties2
functions.signature: VkResult vkGetPhysicalDeviceImageFormatProperties2(VkPhysicalDevice physicalDevice, const VkPhysicalDeviceImageFormatInfo2* pImageFormatInfo, VkImageFormatProperties2* pImageFormatProperties)
functions.description: Query image creation capabilities for a format/usage/tiling/type/flags combination using extensible input and output. Returns VK_SUCCESS if supported, otherwise an error such as VK_ERROR_FORMAT_NOT_SUPPORTED.
requirements: physicalDevice must be valid
pImageFormatInfo must point to VkPhysicalDeviceImageFormatInfo2 with sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_IMAGE_FORMAT_INFO_2 and fields populated (format, type, tiling, usage, flags)
pImageFormatProperties must point to VkImageFormatProperties2 with sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_FORMAT_PROPERTIES_2

functions.name: vkGetPhysicalDeviceQueueFamilyProperties2
functions.signature: void vkGetPhysicalDeviceQueueFamilyProperties2(VkPhysicalDevice physicalDevice, uint32_t* pQueueFamilyPropertyCount, VkQueueFamilyProperties2* pQueueFamilyProperties)
functions.description: Enumerate queue family properties using VkQueueFamilyProperties2, allowing extension structs in pNext. Call once with null properties to get count, then again to fill.
requirements: physicalDevice must be valid
pQueueFamilyPropertyCount must be a valid pointer
If pQueueFamilyProperties is not null, it must have space for at least *pQueueFamilyPropertyCount entries of VkQueueFamilyProperties2

functions.name: vkGetPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties2
functions.signature: void vkGetPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties2(VkPhysicalDevice physicalDevice, VkPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties2* pMemoryProperties)
functions.description: Query memory properties (heaps and types) with support for extension output through pNext.
requirements: physicalDevice must be valid
pMemoryProperties must point to VkPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties2 with sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_MEMORY_PROPERTIES_2

functions.name: vkGetPhysicalDeviceSparseImageFormatProperties2
functions.signature: void vkGetPhysicalDeviceSparseImageFormatProperties2(VkPhysicalDevice physicalDevice, const VkPhysicalDeviceSparseImageFormatInfo2* pFormatInfo, uint32_t* pPropertyCount, VkSparseImageFormatProperties2* pProperties)
functions.description: Query sparse image format properties for a given format/type/samples/usage/tiling combination via the extensible Info2/Properties2 structs.
requirements: physicalDevice must be valid
pFormatInfo must be a valid pointer to VkPhysicalDeviceSparseImageFormatInfo2 with sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_SPARSE_IMAGE_FORMAT_INFO_2
pPropertyCount must be a valid pointer
If pProperties is not null, it must point to an array of at least *pPropertyCount VkSparseImageFormatProperties2 elements

functions.name: vkTrimCommandPool
functions.signature: void vkTrimCommandPool(VkDevice device, VkCommandPool commandPool, VkCommandPoolTrimFlags flags)
functions.description: Hint to the implementation to release unused memory from a command pool back to the system. Non-destructive to allocated command buffers.
requirements: device must be a valid VkDevice
commandPool must be a valid VkCommandPool created on device
flags is a VkCommandPoolTrimFlags bitmask; typically 0 unless extensions define bits

functions.name: vkGetDeviceQueue2
functions.signature: void vkGetDeviceQueue2(VkDevice device, const VkDeviceQueueInfo2* pQueueInfo, VkQueue* pQueue)
functions.description: Retrieve a VkQueue handle from a device using the extensible VkDeviceQueueInfo2 struct (supports device group and sparse flags).
requirements: device must be valid
