pQueueInfo must point to VkDeviceQueueInfo2 with sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEVICE_QUEUE_INFO_2 and valid queueFamilyIndex/queueIndex (and device mask if used)
pQueue must be a valid pointer to receive the queue handle
Requested queue must have been created during vkCreateDevice with at least that index

functions.name: vkGetPhysicalDeviceExternalBufferProperties
functions.signature: void vkGetPhysicalDeviceExternalBufferProperties(VkPhysicalDevice physicalDevice, const VkPhysicalDeviceExternalBufferInfo* pExternalBufferInfo, VkExternalBufferProperties* pExternalBufferProperties)
functions.description: Query external memory handle capabilities for buffers (e.g., export/import handle types). Use to determine compatibility for external sharing.
requirements: physicalDevice must be valid
pExternalBufferInfo must point to VkPhysicalDeviceExternalBufferInfo with sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_EXTERNAL_BUFFER_INFO and fields set (usage, flags, handleType)
pExternalBufferProperties must be a valid pointer to VkExternalBufferProperties (sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_EXTERNAL_BUFFER_PROPERTIES)

functions.name: vkGetPhysicalDeviceExternalFenceProperties
functions.signature: void vkGetPhysicalDeviceExternalFenceProperties(VkPhysicalDevice physicalDevice, const VkPhysicalDeviceExternalFenceInfo* pExternalFenceInfo, VkExternalFenceProperties* pExternalFenceProperties)
functions.description: Query external fence handle capabilities for a physical device.
requirements: physicalDevice must be valid
pExternalFenceInfo must point to VkPhysicalDeviceExternalFenceInfo with sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_EXTERNAL_FENCE_INFO and a valid handleType
pExternalFenceProperties must be a valid pointer to VkExternalFenceProperties

functions.name: vkGetPhysicalDeviceExternalSemaphoreProperties
functions.signature: void vkGetPhysicalDeviceExternalSemaphoreProperties(VkPhysicalDevice physicalDevice, const VkPhysicalDeviceExternalSemaphoreInfo* pExternalSemaphoreInfo, VkExternalSemaphoreProperties* pExternalSemaphoreProperties)
functions.description: Query external semaphore handle capabilities for a physical device.
requirements: physicalDevice must be valid
pExternalSemaphoreInfo must be a valid pointer to VkPhysicalDeviceExternalSemaphoreInfo with sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_EXTERNAL_SEMAPHORE_INFO and a valid handleType
pExternalSemaphoreProperties must be a valid pointer to VkExternalSemaphoreProperties

functions.name: vkCmdDispatchBase
functions.signature: void vkCmdDispatchBase(VkCommandBuffer commandBuffer, uint32_t baseGroupX, uint32_t baseGroupY, uint32_t baseGroupZ, uint32_t groupCountX, uint32_t groupCountY, uint32_t groupCountZ)
functions.description: Record a compute dispatch with an offset (base group) into a command buffer. Use to launch compute workgroups starting at a specified base group and spanning the given group counts. Typical usage: bind a compute pipeline and descriptor sets, then call this to enqueue compute work on the command buffer.
requirements: commandBuffer must be a valid VkCommandBuffer in the recording state
A compute pipeline must be bound to commandBuffer before calling
groupCountX/groupCountY/groupCountZ define the number of workgroups to dispatch; values must be within device limits (exact limits unspecified here; see Vulkan spec)
baseGroupX/baseGroupY/baseGroupZ specify starting workgroup indices; must be within allowed ranges (details unspecified)
May only be called outside a render pass instance
No return value; errors will manifest at queue submission or validation time

functions.name: vkCreateDescriptorUpdateTemplate
functions.signature: VkResult vkCreateDescriptorUpdateTemplate(VkDevice device, const VkDescriptorUpdateTemplateCreateInfo* pCreateInfo, const VkAllocationCallbacks* pAllocator, VkDescriptorUpdateTemplate* pDescriptorUpdateTemplate)
functions.description: Create a descriptor update template object that describes how to populate descriptor sets from a user-provided data blob. Used with vkUpdateDescriptorSetWithTemplate to batch descriptor updates efficiently.
requirements: device must be a valid VkDevice
pCreateInfo must point to a valid VkDescriptorUpdateTemplateCreateInfo
pDescriptorUpdateTemplate must be a valid pointer to receive the created handle
pAllocator may be null or a valid allocator
Returns VK_SUCCESS on success; error codes per Vulkan spec

functions.name: vkDestroyDescriptorUpdateTemplate
functions.signature: void vkDestroyDescriptorUpdateTemplate(VkDevice device, VkDescriptorUpdateTemplate descriptorUpdateTemplate, const VkAllocationCallbacks* pAllocator)
functions.description: Destroy a descriptor update template previously created with vkCreateDescriptorUpdateTemplate.
requirements: device must be a valid VkDevice
descriptorUpdateTemplate may be VK_NULL_HANDLE or a valid VkDescriptorUpdateTemplate created on device
pAllocator must be the same allocator used at creation (or null)
Must not be called while the template is still in use by the device

functions.name: vkUpdateDescriptorSetWithTemplate
functions.signature: void vkUpdateDescriptorSetWithTemplate(VkDevice device, VkDescriptorSet descriptorSet, VkDescriptorUpdateTemplate descriptorUpdateTemplate, const void* pData)
functions.description: Update a descriptor set using a pre-created descriptor update template and a contiguous data block containing descriptor info referenced by the template.
requirements: device must be a valid VkDevice
descriptorSet must be a valid VkDescriptorSet compatible with the template
descriptorUpdateTemplate must be a valid VkDescriptorUpdateTemplate created on device
pData must point to a memory block matching the template’s expected layout
descriptorSet must not be in use by a command buffer at the time of update (unless allowed by spec/flags)

functions.name: vkGetDescriptorSetLayoutSupport
functions.signature: void vkGetDescriptorSetLayoutSupport(VkDevice device, const VkDescriptorSetLayoutCreateInfo* pCreateInfo, VkDescriptorSetLayoutSupport* pSupport)
functions.description: Query whether a proposed descriptor set layout is supported on the device and get additional support details.
requirements: device must be a valid VkDevice
pCreateInfo must point to a valid VkDescriptorSetLayoutCreateInfo describing the layout to test
pSupport must be a valid pointer to receive support information
No return value; pSupport fields indicate support

functions.name: vkCreateSamplerYcbcrConversion
functions.signature: VkResult vkCreateSamplerYcbcrConversion(VkDevice device, const VkSamplerYcbcrConversionCreateInfo* pCreateInfo, const VkAllocationCallbacks* pAllocator, VkSamplerYcbcrConversion* pYcbcrConversion)
functions.description: Create a Y′CBCR sampler conversion object used for sampling multi-planar formats or performing specified chroma reconstruction and color model conversion.
requirements: device must be a valid VkDevice
pCreateInfo must point to a valid VkSamplerYcbcrConversionCreateInfo
pYcbcrConversion must be a valid pointer to receive the created handle
pAllocator optional; pass null for default
Returns VK_SUCCESS on success; other VkResult on failure

functions.name: vkDestroySamplerYcbcrConversion
functions.signature: void vkDestroySamplerYcbcrConversion(VkDevice device, VkSamplerYcbcrConversion ycbcrConversion, const VkAllocationCallbacks* pAllocator)
functions.description: Destroy a Y′CBCR sampler conversion object created with vkCreateSamplerYcbcrConversion.
requirements: device must be a valid VkDevice
ycbcrConversion may be VK_NULL_HANDLE or a valid VkSamplerYcbcrConversion from device
pAllocator must match the allocator used at creation (or null)
Object must not be in use during destruction

functions.name: vkResetQueryPool
functions.signature: void vkResetQueryPool(VkDevice device, VkQueryPool queryPool, uint32_t firstQuery, uint32_t queryCount)
functions.description: Reset a range of queries in a query pool back to an unavailable state so they can be reused.
requirements: device must be a valid VkDevice
queryPool must be a valid VkQueryPool created on device
firstQuery and queryCount must specify a valid range within the pool
No return value; usage errors are validation-time

functions.name: vkGetSemaphoreCounterValue
functions.signature: VkResult vkGetSemaphoreCounterValue(VkDevice device, VkSemaphore semaphore, uint64_t* pValue)
functions.description: Query the current payload (counter) value of a timeline semaphore.
requirements: device must be a valid VkDevice
semaphore must be a valid timeline VkSemaphore
pValue must be a valid pointer to receive the counter value
Returns VK_SUCCESS on success; see spec for error codes (e.g., VK_ERROR_NOT_PERMITTED)

functions.name: vkWaitSemaphores
functions.signature: VkResult vkWaitSemaphores(VkDevice device, const VkSemaphoreWaitInfo* pWaitInfo, uint64_t timeout)
functions.description: Block the host until the specified timeline semaphore(s) reach at least given values or until timeout expires.
requirements: device must be a valid VkDevice
pWaitInfo must point to a valid VkSemaphoreWaitInfo describing semaphores and values
timeout is in nanoseconds; use UINT64_MAX for no timeout
Semaphores in pWaitInfo must be timeline semaphores
Returns VK_SUCCESS, VK_TIMEOUT, or error codes per spec

functions.name: vkSignalSemaphore
functions.signature: VkResult vkSignalSemaphore(VkDevice device, const VkSemaphoreSignalInfo* pSignalInfo)
functions.description: Signal a timeline semaphore on the host to at least the specified payload value.
requirements: device must be a valid VkDevice
pSignalInfo must point to a valid VkSemaphoreSignalInfo; semaphore must be a timeline semaphore
The signaled value must be greater than or equal to the current value
Returns VK_SUCCESS on success; errors per spec

functions.name: vkGetBufferDeviceAddress
functions.signature: VkDeviceAddress vkGetBufferDeviceAddress(VkDevice device, const VkBufferDeviceAddressInfo* pInfo)
functions.description: Query the 64-bit device address for a buffer, used for shader device address features (e.g., ray tracing, device pointers).
requirements: device must be a valid VkDevice with buffer device address feature enabled
pInfo must point to a valid VkBufferDeviceAddressInfo referencing a buffer created with appropriate usage flags
Returns 0 on failure or a valid device address on success

functions.name: vkGetBufferOpaqueCaptureAddress
functions.signature: uint64_t vkGetBufferOpaqueCaptureAddress(VkDevice device, const VkBufferDeviceAddressInfo* pInfo)
functions.description: Get an implementation-defined opaque capture address for a buffer to serialize and later restore device addresses.
requirements: device must be a valid VkDevice
pInfo must point to a valid VkBufferDeviceAddressInfo for a buffer created with capture address support
Return is opaque; only for capture/replay workflows

functions.name: vkGetDeviceMemoryOpaqueCaptureAddress
functions.signature: uint64_t vkGetDeviceMemoryOpaqueCaptureAddress(VkDevice device, const VkDeviceMemoryOpaqueCaptureAddressInfo* pInfo)
functions.description: Get an opaque capture address for a device memory allocation for capture/replay of device addresses.
requirements: device must be a valid VkDevice
pInfo must point to a valid VkDeviceMemoryOpaqueCaptureAddressInfo for memory allocated with the appropriate flag
Return is opaque; only for capture/replay workflows

functions.name: vkCmdDrawIndirectCount
functions.signature: void vkCmdDrawIndirectCount(VkCommandBuffer commandBuffer, VkBuffer buffer, VkDeviceSize offset, VkBuffer countBuffer, VkDeviceSize countBufferOffset, uint32_t maxDrawCount, uint32_t stride)
functions.description: Record multiple indirect non-indexed draws into a command buffer, where the actual draw count is read from a buffer at execution time.
requirements: commandBuffer must be a valid VkCommandBuffer in the recording state
A graphics pipeline compatible with the draw must be bound
buffer must contain an array of VkDrawIndirectCommand; stride specifies the struct stride in bytes
countBuffer must contain the draw count at countBufferOffset
May only be called inside a render pass instance if the pipeline supports it per spec; otherwise typically outside
No return value; errors validated at submission

functions.name: vkCmdDrawIndexedIndirectCount
functions.signature: void vkCmdDrawIndexedIndirectCount(VkCommandBuffer commandBuffer, VkBuffer buffer, VkDeviceSize offset, VkBuffer countBuffer, VkDeviceSize countBufferOffset, uint32_t maxDrawCount, uint32_t stride)
functions.description: Record multiple indirect indexed draws into a command buffer, using a draw count read from a buffer at execution time.
requirements: commandBuffer must be recording
An appropriate graphics pipeline and index buffer must be bound
buffer must contain VkDrawIndexedIndirectCommand entries with given stride
countBuffer must contain the draw count value
Render pass usage must follow the pipeline/subpass rules; see spec

functions.name: vkCreateRenderPass2
functions.signature: VkResult vkCreateRenderPass2(VkDevice device, const VkRenderPassCreateInfo2* pCreateInfo, const VkAllocationCallbacks* pAllocator, VkRenderPass* pRenderPass)
functions.description: Create a render pass object using the newer VkRenderPassCreateInfo2 structure, allowing extended subpass and attachment configuration.
requirements: device must be a valid VkDevice
pCreateInfo must point to a valid VkRenderPassCreateInfo2
pRenderPass must be a valid pointer to receive the handle
pAllocator optional; pass null for default
Returns VK_SUCCESS or an error VkResult per spec

functions.name: vkCmdBeginRenderPass2
